user.title: Create a shopping route
user.description: Shopping item names and section descriptions are sent to the selected AI Task provider. Classifications are cached in Home Assistant storage for this profile.

data.display_section_prefix: Prefix item names with their section
data.ai_match: Ask the AI Task to choose when two products are equally close

data_description.sections: One section per line: SECTION NAME | optional hints. Line order is the walking route.
data_description.display_section_prefix: Only changes how the calculated list is displayed. The source list is never renamed.
data_description.price_chain: Optional. Sends each item name or pinned query to the chosen retailer's anonymous product search. Choose no prices to send names only to the AI Task.
data_description.price_store_id: Pak'nSave: enter the exact store name or retailer ID. The name is resolved and saved for the shopping card. Leave blank for Woolworths: its online prices are not store-specific.
data_description.grocer_store_id: Optional named public store for historical observations. Must match the retailer and, for Pak'nSave, the current-price store. Woolworths history is store-specific but its current online quote is not. New stores may require an integration update. No imported history keeps local observations only.
data_description.ai_match: Sends the item name and the closest product names to your AI provider when the price search cannot tell two products apart. The answer is remembered so a price never flips between refreshes.

reconfigure.title: Edit shopping route
reconfigure.description: Changing route order does not reclassify items. Use Reclassify all after material hint changes. Old product/store histories remain backed up but are not reused for a different identity.

error.malformed_sections: A section line contains more than one | separator.
error.reserved_section: Unclassified / Other is added automatically and cannot be configured.
error.duplicate_section: Section names must be unique, ignoring case.
error.no_sections: Add at least one route section.
error.source_not_found: The source to-do entity does not exist.
error.source_is_route: A Smart Shopping Route entity cannot be used as a source.
error.source_no_update: The source must support updating to-do items.

error.ai_task_no_generate_data: The AI Task does not support Generate data.
error.duplicate_profile_name: A profile with this name already exists.
error.price_store_required: Choose a Pak'nSave store for price lookups.
error.price_store_not_found: No Pak'nSave store matched that name.
error.price_store_ambiguous: More than one store matched; use the store ID.
error.price_store_unavailable: The Pak'nSave store list could not be reached.
error.grocer_store_invalid: Choose a valid positive grocer.nz store ID.
error.grocer_store_not_found: Store is not in this release's public catalogue. Update the integration or choose no imported history.
error.grocer_store_chain_mismatch: The history store must belong to the selected retailer.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Refresh from the source and classify unknown items.

set_item_section.name: Set item section
set_item_section.description: Correct the route section for a source item UID.

item_uid.name: Source item UID
item_uid.description: The stable UID of the authoritative source item, as shown by the source to-do integration.

remember.name: Remember
remember.description: Reuse this correction for future matching summaries.

forget_item_section.name: Forget item section
forget_item_section.description: Forget a classification and try it again.

item_uid.name: Source item UID
item_uid.description: The stable UID of the authoritative source item.

reclassify_all.name: Reclassify all
reclassify_all.description: Clear AI classifications and classify current items again. This can incur provider charges.

clear_cache.name: Clear cache
clear_cache.description: Clear cached AI classifications, preserving manual overrides by default.

include_manual.name: Include manual overrides
include_manual.description: Also erase explicit manual corrections, including per-item corrections.

pin_item_product.name: Pin item product
pin_item_product.description: Tell the price lookup which product an item means, then re-price it.

item_uid.name: Source item UID
item_uid.description: The stable UID of the authoritative source item.

query.name: Search text
query.description: Product words to search for instead of the item name, such as a brand and product type.

product_id.name: Product ID
product_id.description: Optional exact retailer product ID. When set, only that product is accepted.

grocer_product_id.name: grocer.nz product ID
grocer_product_id.description: Optional. Pin the exact grocer.nz product for price history, when automatic matching picks a sibling variant. The number is in the product's URL on grocer.nz.

unpin_item_product.name: Unpin item product
unpin_item_product.description: Forget a pinned product and go back to automatic matching.

item_uid.name: Source item UID
item_uid.description: The stable UID of the authoritative source item.
